item.title: Biblical Submission: Christlike Strength, Not Silence
item.description: Few biblical teachings are more misunderstood today than submission. In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains what Scripture truly means by biblical submission—and what it does not mean. Rooted in Ephesians 5:22–33 and 1 Peter 3:1–7, this episode shows that biblical submission is a voluntary, joyful, Christ-centered posture of respect and support that flows from trust in the Lord and reflects the relationship between Christ and His church.

item.title: God Speaks Through Suffering: Job 32–33
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins examines Job 32–33, where Elihu explains how God speaks through suffering to awaken, humble, and restore His people, pointing ultimately to Jesus Christ, the true Mediator and Ransom.

item.title: Why Biblical Theology Matters for Discernment
item.description: Biblical discernment requires more than spotting errors. Learn why biblical theology matters and how Scripture as one story guards against false teaching.

item.title: Marriage Is a Picture of the Gospel (Ephesians 5:25–32)
item.description: Marriage is not ultimately about personal happiness or cultural preference. This episode of Contending for the Word Q&A explains how marriage is a God-designed picture of the gospel, reflecting Christ’s sacrificial love for the church and the church’s faithful response, rooted in Ephesians 5:25–32.

item.title: Jesus Our Bridegroom: Finding True Love That Fills the Empty Heart
item.description: In this episode of New Age to Christ, we explore the biblical truth of Jesus as our Bridegroom and how the gospel offers lasting love, hope, and healing for the empty heart.

item.title: God’s Justice Stands Firm Even When Life Feels Unfair (Job 34–35)
item.description: In Job 34–35, Elihu defends the perfect justice, righteousness, and impartiality of God. These chapters call us to trust God’s justice even when life feels unfair and point us to Christ where justice and mercy meet.

item.title: Biblical Manhood: Servant Leadership, Responsibility, and Repentance
item.description: What does it mean to be a godly man in a confused age? In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins continues the February 2026 series Marriage & Family: God’s Design for the Home by examining biblical manhood through the lens of Scripture. From Genesis 2:15 to Ephesians 5:25, this message shows that biblical manhood is neither harsh nor passive but marked by responsibility, humility, repentance, and sacrificial love.
